title: Thunderstorm
tldr: Go inside a substantial building or a fully enclosed hard-top vehicle when thunder is heard. Stay away from windows and monitor warnings for damaging wind, hail, tornadoes and flash flooding.
steps: Open shelters, tents and trees do not protect from lightning.
Inside, avoid plumbing and plugged-in equipment during lightning.
Move to an interior room for severe wind or hail; use a tornado shelter if a tornado warning is issued.
After the last thunder, wait at least 30 minutes before resuming outdoor activity.
next: Check for downed lines and flooded routes before travel. Schedule outdoor work around forecasts.
watch: Every thunderstorm can produce lightning, even without a severe thunderstorm warning.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Use a substantial building or enclosed hard-top vehicle even when warnings cannot be checked. Avoid plumbing and wired electrical equipment during lightning. Watch for rising water and damaging wind without going outside to observe the storm.
household: Account for children, older people, pets and anyone who needs assistance before moving. Keep shoes, medicines and a torch in the shelter area. Decide who helps whom and who carries the essential supplies; do not send a lone child to retrieve items.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
